loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

Only a report delivered through SubagentHandback reaches your caller; plain text you write at the end of your run is NOT delivered. There is no recipient parameter: the report can only go to your caller.

entries.name: WebFetch
entries.description:
Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model.

- Fails on authenticated/private URLs — use an authenticated MCP tool or `gh` for those instead. claude.ai artifact links (claude.ai/artifact/{id} or claude.ai/code/artifact/{uuid}) are published artifacts: read them with the Artifact tool (action "read"), not WebFetch or curl.
- Fails on localhost and other hostnames without a dot; for a local server, use curl via Bash.
- HTTP is upgraded to HTTPS. Cross-host redirects are returned to you rather than followed; call again with the redirect URL.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

prompt.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content

offset.description: Character position in the page text to start reading from. Use it to read on through a page too long for one call, with the value the previous result gave.

entries.name: WebSearch
entries.description:
Search the web. Returns result blocks with titles and URLs. US-only.

**Launch date:** September 23, 2025. The article gives a limited-time price starting at 93,700 yuan for the Xingrui.

**Models and prices** (list price / limited-time price, in 10k yuan)

*Xingrui (星瑞·东方曜) sedan*
- 1.5TD + 7DCT 惊鸿版: 9.87 / 9.37
- 1.5TD + 7DCT 扶摇版: 10.47 / 9.97
- 1.5TD + 7DCT 昆仑版: 10.97 / 10.47
- 2.0TD + 8AT 霄汉版: 11.87 / 11.37
- 2.0TD + 8AT 揽星版: 12.97 / 12.47
- 2.0TD + 8AT 望月版: 13.87 / 13.37

*Xingyue L (星越 L·东方曜) SUV*
- 2.0TD + 8AT 霄汉版: 15.87 / 14.57
- 2.0TD + 8AT 揽星版: 16.87 / 15.57
- 2.0TD + 8AT 望月版: 17.97 / 16.67

**New features vs. the previous version**

*Xingrui*
- **Exterior:** Three new paint colors (Magnolia Black, Mogao Blue, Crescent Green) replace two former options. The front bumper gets new fake air-intake shapes, and the styling adds Peking Opera facial-makeup and cloud motifs.
- **Screen/cabin:** New instrument cluster with a "small brim" design, a new electronic gear selector, and a dedicated one-touch start button. The 2.0T drops its paddle shifters.
- **Chip/head unit:** Adds the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 chip.
- **Audio/comfort:** The 1.5T entry trim gets an 8-speaker system. The top 1.5T trim (昆仑版) gets 50W wireless phone charging and 256-color ambient lighting.
- **ADAS:** The 1.5T gains rear collision warning, reverse side-vehicle warning, door-opening warning, and lane-change assist.
- **Engine:** The 1.5T is unchanged (133 kW, 290 N·m, 7DCT). The 2.0T is new, with a larger turbo, 200 kW, 400 N·m (up 25 kW and 50 N·m), and an Aisin 8-speed automatic.

*Xingyue L*
- **Exterior:** Adds a Mogao Blue color, a recessed grille design, and removes the chrome strip below the front bumper.
- **Screen:** Dual screens grow from 12.3 to 14.6 inches and move from an embedded to a floating, connected design.
- **Cabin:** The climate controls move below the center vents, there is a new electronic gear selector, and dual front cup holders are added.
- **Engine:** A new 2.0T with a larger turbo (200 kW, 400 N·m, up 25 kW and 50 N·m) and an Aisin 8-speed automatic. The top 望月版 offers optional all-wheel drive (Borg Warner 6th-gen system); other trims are front-wheel drive.
- **ADAS:** Both models get the Qianli Haohan H3 driver-assistance package, with AEB that can bring the car to a stop from up to 120 km/h.

**Not covered in the article:** Seat and suspension changes are not mentioned for either model. The article also does not specify a screen change or chip for the Xingyue L.

content.content:
**Launch:** The refreshed Geely 星瑞·东方曜 (Xingrui Dongfangyao) and 星越L·东方曜 (Xingyue L Dongfangyao) went on sale on October 27 (the article is dated 2024-10-27). The article says the update covers "车机、动力、配置等方面".

**Models and guide prices**

- **星瑞·东方曜 (Xingrui):** 5 trims, 9.97–13.87万 yuan
  - 1.5TD+7DCT: 惊鸿版 9.97, 扶摇版 10.87, 昆仑版 11.47
  - 2.0TD+8AT: 揽星版 12.97, 望月版 13.87
- **星越L·东方曜 (Xingyue L):** 2 trims, 16.97–17.97万 yuan
  - 2.0TD+8AT: 揽星版 16.97, 望月版 17.97

**Xingrui: changes**

- **Infotainment and chip:** Standard 14.6-inch central screen and 12.3-inch digital cluster, with the new FlymeAuto system.
- **ADAS:** Entry trims add L2 driver assistance. Higher trims add lane-change assist and blind-spot monitoring.
- **Comfort and audio:** Higher trims add in-car fragrance and a 10-speaker Infinity audio system. Top trims add wireless phone charging and a 7.5-inch HUD. Seats use suede panels.
- **Chassis:** Entry trims add a 540° transparent chassis view.
- **Engine:** The 2.0T now pairs with an Aisin 8AT and makes 238 hp and 350 N·m, up 48 hp and 50 N·m. The 1.5T (133 kW) keeps its 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox.
- **Colors:** New 云砚磨砂灰 and 东方青, plus trim-specific 采青 (1.5T) and 石绿 (2.0T).

**Xingyue L: changes**

- **Displays and HUD:** Three 12.3-inch screens (cluster, central, passenger) and an AR-HUD. The article's headline cites a 25.6-inch AR-HUD, which conflicts with the body text.
- **Software and chip:** Galaxy OS 2.0 with an 8155 chip.
- **ADAS:** Full-speed adaptive cruise, lane-keeping assist, and blind-spot monitoring.
- **Interior:** Physical buttons under the central screen are replaced by knobs, and the gear selector is crystal.
- **Audio and seats:** 12-speaker Infinity system with three sound modes. Front seats have heating, ventilation, and massage. An optional pack adds heated steering wheel, backrest, and rear seats.
- **Engine and drivetrain:** 2.0T (175 kW) with 8AT, in front-wheel and all-wheel drive. Standard CCD variable-damping suspension. Top trim uses a BorgWarner 6th-gen electro-hydraulic AWD system.
- **Colors:** Five standard colors, including the new 东方青, and optional 远黛磨砂灰.

**Note:** The article doesn't say which Xingyue L features are new versus the previous model, so I haven't labeled them as upgrades. The page footer shows 2026, but the article's timestamp is 2024.

content.content:
**Model:** Tank 500 Hi4-T, a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) version of Great Wall Motor's off-road SUV, the Tank 500.

**Launch:** Presale began in April 2023 at the Shanghai Auto Show. The PHEV became available for purchase in June, and deliveries started in July 2023.

**Price:** From 335,000 yuan (about 45,800 USD).

**Features:**
- 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder gasoline engine, rated at 300 kW and 750 Nm
- Nine-speed hydraulic automatic transmission with an integrated 150 kW electric motor, plus four-wheel drive
- 37.1 kWh battery at the rear of the chassis
- Pure electric range above 100 km (WLTC)
- Hybrid fuel consumption of 2.3 L/100 km (WLTC)
- Same exterior design as the V6 version

**Sales (2023):**
- Over 20,000 orders after the April presale
- 9,328 retail sales since deliveries began in July
- 4,269 units in the most recent month reported, the second-best-selling Tank model
- 10th-best-selling PHEV that month and 13th over the past three months

The article contains no 2022 sales figures.

**Launch and price**
- Launched January 1 (2025). It has one configuration priced at 363,800 yuan (about 49,850 USD), over 10,000 yuan cheaper than the December pre-sale price.

**Hi4-Z specs**
- **Dimensions:** 5078 × 1934 × 1905 mm; wheelbase 2850 mm
- **Battery:** 59.05 kWh NCM, 201 km WLTC electric range
- **Total range:** 1096 km (WLTC)
- **Engine and drive:** 2.0T E20NB engine (185 kW, 380 Nm) with a three-speed hybrid DHT; two motors give a combined 635 kW and 1195 Nm peak
- **Performance:** 0-100 km/h in 4.6 seconds; fuel consumption 8.6 L/100km
- **Charging:** 163 kW fast charging; 30% to 80% in about 15 minutes
- **Off-road:** 210 mm minimum ground clearance, 29° approach angle, 24° departure angle

**What's new vs. the Hi4-T**
- **Drivetrain:** a new decoupled four-wheel-drive structure, which GWM says offers better off-road ability than other PHEV off-roaders.
- **Battery placement:** the Hi4-T's battery sits under the trunk floor, limiting both trunk space and battery size. The Hi4-Z places the battery between the axles, allowing the larger 59.05 kWh pack.
- **Suspension:** the rear multi-link integral axle is retained, with longer travel.
- **Unchanged:** exterior (apart from badges) and mostly the interior, including the 12.3-inch instrument display, 14.6-inch infotainment screen, and Coffee OS 3.0. The article says the Hi4-Z is not a replacement for the Hi4-T.

**2024 sales numbers**
- The article does not provide any Tank 500 sales figures for 2024. It only mentions that the Hi4-Z attracted 6,000 orders in the first 24 hours of pre-sales, which is not the same as deliveries or sales.
